column2: The harmless hoverfly gains protection through mimicry, since its yellow stripes imitate those of a stinging wasp.
column3: 無害的食蚜蠅靠擬態獲得保護，因為牠的黃色條紋模仿了會螫人的黃蜂。
column5: mimic 模仿 + ry，像默劇演員 mime 在模仿別人

column2: Isolation on separate islands can lead to speciation, as each finch population slowly evolves into a distinct species.
column3: 被隔離在不同島嶼上可能導致物種形成，因為每群雀鳥慢慢演化成不同的物種。
column4: lead to speciation (導致物種形成)
column5: species 物種 + ation，產生新 species 的過程

column2: Rainforests hold extraordinary biodiversity, sheltering millions of plant, insect, and animal species in a small area.
column3: 雨林擁有驚人的生物多樣性，在小範圍內庇護了數百萬種植物、昆蟲和動物。
column5: bio 生命 + diversity 多樣，生命花樣越多越豐富
column7: bi - o - di - ver - si - ty

column2: The male peacock displays brilliant blue plumage to attract a mate.
column3: 雄孔雀展示亮麗的藍色羽毛來吸引配偶。
column5: plume 羽毛 + age 總稱，一整身的羽毛打扮

column2: Bears hibernate through the winter, living off stored body fat inside a sheltered den.
column3: 熊在冬天冬眠，靠儲存的體脂肪躲在隱蔽的洞穴裡過冬。
column4: hibernate all winter (整個冬天冬眠)
column5: hibernate 諧音「嗨伯內」，冬天來了先打招呼再鑽進被窩睡

column2: During hibernation, a ground squirrel's heart rate drops to only a few beats per minute.
column3: 冬眠期間，地松鼠的心跳降到每分鐘只剩幾下。
column4: emerge from hibernation (結束冬眠醒來)
column5: hibernate 的名詞，冬天那一整段長長的睡眠

column2: Some snails undergo estivation, sealing themselves inside their shells to survive a hot, dry summer.
column3: 有些蝸牛會夏眠，把自己封在殼裡熬過炎熱乾燥的夏天。
column5: est 來自拉丁文「夏天」，與冬眠 hibernation 剛好相反

column2: Microbial activity in the soil breaks down dead leaves and returns nutrients to the ground.
column3: 土壤中的微生物活動會分解落葉，並把養分還給土地。
column5: micro 微小 + bial 生物的，小小生物的

column2: A single-celled amoeba is the simplest kind of living organism in this pond.
column3: 單細胞的變形蟲是這座池塘裡最簡單的生物。
column5: organ 器官 + ism，由器官組成的完整生命

column2: Wetlands provide a vital habitat for migrating ducks, frogs, and dragonflies.
column3: 濕地為遷徙的鴨子、青蛙和蜻蜓提供重要的棲息地。
column5: habit 習慣 + at，動物習慣待著的地方

column2: Each warbler species feeds in a different part of the tree, so every one fills its own niche.
column3: 每種林鶯在樹的不同部位覓食，所以各自占有自己的生態棲位。
column4: occupy a niche (占據生態棲位)
column5: niche 諧音「你吸」，你吸這邊的蟲，我吸那邊的，各有角落

column2: The thick fur of the Arctic fox is an adaptation that helps it survive freezing winters.
column3: 北極狐濃密的毛皮是一種適應特徵，幫助牠熬過嚴寒的冬天。
column4: adaptation to cold (對寒冷的適應)
column5: adapt 適應 + ation，長出剛好合用的工具來配合環境

column2: A long neck was an adaptive trait for giraffes that fed on tall acacia trees.
column3: 長脖子對以高大金合歡樹為食的長頸鹿來說，是一項具適應優勢的特徵。
column5: adapt 適應 + ive 有...性質，讓生物活得更好的

column2: Squirrels forage on the forest floor for acorns to store before winter arrives.
column3: 松鼠在林地上四處尋找橡實，趁冬天來臨前儲存起來。
column5: forage 諧音「佛瑞居」，松鼠老是出門找吃的，不在家

column2: The wolf, a skilled predator, stalks elk herds for hours before choosing a weak animal.
column3: 狼是技巧高明的掠食者，會跟蹤麋鹿群好幾個小時，才挑出虛弱的目標。
column5: pred 像 prey 獵物，predator 就是追獵物的角色

column2: Heavy predation by cats has reduced the number of ground-nesting birds on the island.
column3: 貓的大量捕食使島上在地面築巢的鳥類數量減少。
column5: predator 掠食者的名詞，掠食者所做的事

column2: Owls prey on mice, hunting silently in the dark with sharp hearing.
column3: 貓頭鷹以老鼠為食，憑著靈敏的聽覺在黑暗中悄悄獵捕。
column5: prey 與 pray 同音，獵物在祈禱：拜託別抓我
column8: 被捕食的獵物；捕食為食

column2: The island's flora includes rare orchids found nowhere else on Earth.
column3: 島上的植物群包括世界上別處找不到的稀有蘭花。
column5: Flora 是羅馬的花神，花神管所有的植物

column2: Marine fauna on the reef includes sea turtles, rays, and thousands of colorful fish.
column3: 這座珊瑚礁的海洋動物群包括海龜、魟魚和數千種色彩繽紛的魚。
column5: Fauna 是羅馬傳說的森林女神，管所有的動物

column2: A lizard is a reptile, so it relies on warm sunlight to heat its scaly body.
column3: 蜥蜴是爬行動物，需要靠溫暖的陽光讓有鱗片的身體暖起來。
column5: rept 有爬行的意思，像蛇和蜥蜴貼著地面爬

column2: The frog is an amphibian: it begins life in water as a tadpole and later lives on land.
column3: 青蛙是兩棲動物：牠一開始以蝌蚪的樣子在水中生活，後來住在陸地上。
column5: amphi 雙重 + bio 生命，過兩種生活：水裡和陸地

column2: An octopus is an invertebrate with no backbone, yet it solves puzzles remarkably well.
column3: 章魚是沒有脊骨的無脊椎動物，卻很會解謎。
column5: in 沒有 + vertebra 脊椎，沒有背骨的軟軟動物

column2: Fish, birds, and humans are all vertebrates, each with a spine that supports the body.
column3: 魚、鳥和人類都是脊椎動物，各有一條支撐身體的脊柱。
column5: vertebra 脊椎骨的骨節可以轉動，背上一串可彎的骨頭

column2: A tick is a parasite that attaches itself to a dog and drinks its blood.
column3: 蜱是會附著在狗身上吸血的寄生蟲。
column5: para 旁邊 + site 食物，賴在別人旁邊白吃白喝

column2: Mosquitoes spread malaria by carrying the parasite from one host to another.
column3: 蚊子攜帶寄生蟲從一個宿主傳到另一個宿主，因而傳播瘧疾。
column5: host 是請客的主人，寄生蟲把你當成請它吃飯的主人

column2: Bees carry pollen between blossoms, and this pollination allows apple trees to produce fruit.
column3: 蜜蜂在花朵間帶著花粉，這項授粉讓蘋果樹得以結果。
column5: pollen 花粉 + ation，把花粉送到另一朵花的過程

column2: Hummingbirds are the main pollinators of the red tubular flowers growing on this mountain.
column3: 蜂鳥是這座山上紅色管狀花的主要傳粉者。
column5: pollen 花粉 + ator 做事的人，花粉快遞員

column2: Bean seeds germinate within a week if the soil stays warm and moist.
column3: 只要土壤保持溫暖濕潤，豆種一星期內就會發芽。
column5: germ 有「胚芽」的意思，小芽從種子裡冒出來

column2: Cold temperatures delay the germination of many seeds until spring arrives.
column3: 低溫使許多種子延後到春天才發芽。
column5: germinate 的名詞，種子醒來伸出小芽的過程

column2: Chlorophyll gives leaves their green color and captures the sunlight needed to make food.
column3: 葉綠素使葉子呈現綠色，並捕捉製造養分所需的陽光。
column4: chlorophyll in leaves (葉子裡的葉綠素)
column5: chloro 綠色 + phyll 葉子，字面就是綠葉

column2: Each chloroplast inside a plant cell is a tiny green factory where photosynthesis takes place.
column3: 植物細胞裡的每個葉綠體，都是進行光合作用的綠色小工廠。
column4: chloroplast in cells (細胞中的葉綠體)
column5: chloro 綠 + plast 小體，綠色的小工廠

column2: Cellular damage from too much sun can eventually lead to skin problems.
column3: 曬太陽過度造成的細胞損傷，最後可能導致皮膚問題。
column5: cell 細胞 + ular 的，像手機 cell phone 一格一格的小單位

column2: Her interest in genetics began when she noticed that every child in the family had red hair.
column3: 她對遺傳學的興趣，始於注意到家裡每個孩子都是紅頭髮。
column5: gene 基因 + tics 學問，專門研究基因的學科

column2: A single mutation in one gene can change the color of a flower's petals.
column3: 單一基因的突變就能改變花瓣的顏色。
column5: mutation 像 X 戰警的 mutant 突變人，身體密碼改變了

column2: Brown eyes depend on a dominant allele, while blue eyes result from a recessive one.
column3: 棕色眼睛取決於顯性等位基因，藍色眼睛則來自隱性等位基因。
column5: allele 諧音「阿里歐」，同一個位置上不同版本的兄弟

column2: Humans normally have forty-six chromosomes, tightly coiled strands of DNA found inside each cell.
column3: 人類通常有四十六條染色體，是每個細胞內緊緊纏繞的DNA長鏈。
column5: chromo 顏色 + some 小體，能被染上顏色的小東西

column2: An enzyme in saliva starts breaking down starch as soon as you chew bread.
column3: 唾液中的酵素在你一咀嚼麵包時就開始分解澱粉。
column5: en 在裡面 + zyme 酵母，酵母裡的催化小幫手

column2: Eggs, beans, and fish supply the protein your muscles need to grow after exercise.
column3: 蛋、豆類和魚提供肌肉在運動後生長所需的蛋白質。
column5: pro 第一 + tein，蛋白質是身體第一重要的建材

column2: Rice and bread are rich in carbohydrate, which the body converts into quick energy.
column3: 米飯和麵包富含碳水化合物，身體會將它轉化為快速的能量。
column5: carbo 碳 + hydr 水 + ate，碳加水組成的東西

column2: Because teenagers have a fast metabolism, they often feel hungry soon after eating a meal.
column3: 因為青少年新陳代謝快，所以常在吃完飯不久後就覺得餓。
column5: meta 改變 + bol 像 ball，食物不斷被轉成能量
